Environmental Compliance
Environmental compliance is a fundamental responsibility at every stage of construction and commissioning. At CEO Villa, all mechanical HVAC systems have been designed and commissioned in full accordance with international environmental standards. Refrigerant handling follows strict ASHRAE and Saudi EPA guidelines. Acoustic performance, ventilation rates, insulation compliance, leak tests, and indoor air quality records are all documented and maintained for regulatory accountability. SECTION 2 — TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
Technology
Bipolar Ionization — Generates positive (+) and negative (−) ions simultaneously
Power Consumption
Maximum 16 Watts
Voltage
Model 201: 120V AC | Model 202: 230V AC
Frequency
50 Hz or 60 Hz
Secondary Voltage (Ionizing Tubes)
2,900 Volts AC (High voltage ionization)
Overcurrent Protection
Breaker not exceeding 20 Amps
Ionization Tube Configuration
Two-tube system with adjustable ionization level
Mounting
Installed in metallic ductwork — does not compromise duct structural integrity
Maximum Duct Air Temperature
Not to exceed 140°F (60°C)
Installation Manual Reference
Ion Generator Plasma Air 200 Installation Operation and Maintenance Manual.pdf
SECTION 3 — INDOOR AIR QUALITY (IAQ) BENEFITS
Primary Function
Reduces harmful airborne pollutants, contaminants, and odors in the supply air stream
Pollutant Reduction
Positive and negative ions attach to airborne particles, bacteria, viruses, mold spores, and VOCs — causing them to cluster and be captured by filters
Odor Elimination
Ions neutralize odor-causing molecules in the air
Pathogen Reduction
Bipolar ionization inactivates airborne pathogens (bacteria and viruses)
Particulate Reduction
Ions cause fine particles to agglomerate (clump together), improving filter capture efficiency
No Harmful By-products
Does not generate harmful ozone levels — safe for occupied spaces
Energy Impact
Passive technology — 16W only — negligible energy consumption
Applicable Standards
UL Listed (verified by UL label on unit) | Suitable for ASHRAE 62.1 IAQ compliance
SECTION 4 — ENVIRONMENTAL AND REGULATORY COMPLIANCE
ODP (Ozone Depletion Potential)
Zero — No refrigerants or ozone-depleting substances used
GWP (Global Warming Potential)
Zero — No refrigerants used. Purely electrical ionization technology
Chemical Emissions
None — No chemicals, filters, or consumables used during operation
Maintenance Requirements
Periodic cleaning of ionization tubes — No chemical replacement required
Safety Listing
UL Listed — Compliant with electrical safety standards
Environmental Category
Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Enhancement Device — No environmental harm
ASHRAE 62.1 Relevance
Supports ventilation effectiveness and IAQ requirements per ASHRAE 62.1
LEED Contribution
Contributes to LEED EQ Credit — Enhanced Indoor Air Quality Strategies
